facts.fact_text: On 24 May 2012, opposition groups were planning to hold a demonstration.
The second applicant was planning to participate in the demonstration planned for 24 May 2012.
The second applicant complained under Article 11 of the Convention of a violation of his right to freedom of assembly.
The applications concern the administrative arrest of the applicants prior to a demonstration.
The applications concern the detention of the applicants prior to a demonstration.
The arrests and detention of the applicants occurred prior to a demonstration.
At 9.55 a.m. on 24 May 2012, the second applicant was walking with his grandson when he was stopped by two plainclothes police officers.
The two plainclothes police officers invited the second applicant to the police station at 9.55 a.m. on 24 May 2012.
The second applicant went with the police officers to the police station on 24 May 2012.
The second applicant was held at the police station for around seven hours on 24 May 2012.
At 5 p.m. on 24 May 2012, the second applicant was brought before the Binagadi District Court.

The Binagadi District Court found the second applicant guilty of the administrative offence of failure to comply with a lawful request of a police officer under Article 310 of the Code of Administrative Offences of Azerbaijan.
The Binagadi District Court sentenced the second applicant to a fine of 20 Azerbaijani manats (approximately 20 euros at the material time).
In his appeal, the second applicant claimed that he had been arrested to prevent him from participating in the demonstration of 24 May 2012.

The Binagadi District Court found the second applicant guilty of the administrative offence of failure to comply with a lawful request of a police officer under Article 310 of the Code of Administrative Offences of Azerbaijan.
In his appeal, the second applicant claimed that the Binagadi District Court had not given reasons for its decision.
In his appeal, the second applicant claimed that he had been arrested to prevent him from participating in the demonstration of 24 May 2012.
By a final decision of 21 June 2012, the Baku Court of Appeal dismissed the second applicant's appeal as unsubstantiated.
